title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: cluster role inputs
description: The rendered terraform.tfvars.json of a TerraformCluster apply (common.md, cluster.md). Module inputs are exactly the contract inputs: no other properties.

captf_cluster_outputs.description: Not rendered for the cluster role (the key is absent); accepted as null for compatibility.

control_plane_endpoint.description: An endpoint the module does not own, or null (cluster.md).

kubernetes_version.description: Cluster.spec.topology.version, or null without a ClusterClass topology.

cluster_network.description: Cluster.spec.clusterNetwork, or null when the Cluster sets none of it.
